name: Should I resurface or replace my deck?

mainEntity.name: Should I resurface or replace my deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between resurfacing and replacement hinges on your deck's structural integrity. If the foundational elements—joists, beams, and support posts—are in excellent condition, resurfacing is often a cost-effective choice. However, if there's widespread rot, significant structural damage, or major instability, a full replacement is usually safer and more durable. A professional inspection, like those offered by Hometelligent Inc. in Dublin or Livermore, can accurately determine the best course of action by assessing the underlying structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose resurfacing if the deck's substructure is sound; replace if there's extensive structural damage or rot. A professional inspection helps decide.
